status_boundary: source-backed theorem-strength comparison only; no fixed-modulus binary AP theorem, q286 signed-projection theorem, strict-central existence theorem, or Goldbach proof is established

q286_obligation.statement: For M=286, A_a={u in U : a-u in U}, centered first-three coefficient gamma_a(u), strict-central weighted binary-prime residue weights W_N(u), and T_N=sum_u W_N(u), prove sum_{u in A_a}(W_N(u)-T_N/|A_a|)*gamma_a(u) >= -tau*T_N for every sufficiently large even N==a mod 286.

comparison_result.narrower_remaining_opportunity: Prove only the one-sided projection against gamma_a, rather than a full per-residue AP asymptotic.
